# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  42  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  43  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  44  0000              ; Build options
  45  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  46  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  47  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  48  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  49  0000
  50  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  51  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  52  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  53  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  54  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  55  0000
  56  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  57  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  58  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  59  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  60  0000
  61  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  62  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  63  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  64  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  65  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  66  0000
  67  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  68  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  69  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  70  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  71  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  72  0000
  73  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
  74  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
  75  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
  76  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
  77  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
  78  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
  79  0000
  80  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
  81  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
  82  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
  83  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
  84  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
  85  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
  86  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
  87  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
  88  0000

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data
  17+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  18+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  19+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  21+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  22+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menu, level
  23+ 0000              ;                 loading
  24+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  25+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  26+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  27+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  28+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  29+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  30+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  31+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  32+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  33+ 0000
  34+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  35+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  36+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  37+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  38+ 0000
  39+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  47+ 0000
  48+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  56+ 0000
  57+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  58+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  59+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  60+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  61+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  62+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  63+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  64+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  65+ 0000
  66+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  67+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  68+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  69+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  70+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  71+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  74+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  75+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  76+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  77+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  78+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  79+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  80+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  81+ 0000
  82+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  83+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  86+ 0000
  87+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  88+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  89+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  90+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  91+ 0000
  92+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
  93+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
  94+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
  95+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
  96+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
  97+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
  98+ 0000
  99+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 100+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 101+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 102+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 103+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 104+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 105+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 106+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 107+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 108+ 0000
 109+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 110+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 111+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 112+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 113+ 0000
 114+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 115+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 116+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 117+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 118+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 119+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 120+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 123+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 124+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 126+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 127+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 128+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 129+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 130+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 131+ 0000
 132+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 133+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 134+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 135+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 136+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 137+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 138+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 139+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 140+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 141+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 142+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 143+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 145+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: main menu (slot 6)
 147+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 148+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 149+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 150+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 151+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 152+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 153+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 155+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 157+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 158+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 159+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 161+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 162+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 166+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 168+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 170+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 35          ; the figures' graphics (pages 35 to
 172+ 0000                                                      ; 35+GFX_PAGES_MAX-1), loaded from
 173+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 174+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 175+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 176+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 177+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 178+ 0000
 179+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 180+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 181+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 182+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 183+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 185+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 186+ 0000
 187+ 0000              PAGE_ROM                equ $FF         ; MMU value: ROM in slots 0-1

  91  0000
  92  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  93  0000              ; Tuning constants
  94  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  95  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
  96  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
  97  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
  98  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
  99  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 100  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 101  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 102  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height
 103  0000              ; level, PAD_CODE, TERRACE_CODE, VOID_CODE: out of bounds), bit 6 set while a human waits in the cell
 104  0000              ; (human.asm, hum_flags), bit 7 while a zombie or special monster stands in
 105  0000              ; it (zombie.asm, zflags; its type is in its record).  Bit 5 is free.  So
 106  0000              ; every reader masks with CELL_CODE before testing for road or a code.
 107  0000              CELL_CODE       equ %00011111
 108  0000              CELL_FLAGS      equ %11100000       ; (the marks, kept when the code changes)
 109  0000              CELL_HUMAN_B    equ 6
 110  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE_B   equ 7
 111  0000              CELL_HUMAN      equ 1<<CELL_HUMAN_B
 112  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE     equ 1<<CELL_ZOMBIE_B
 113  0000              TILE_M          equ 20          ; metres per tile (reference scale)
 114  0000              TILE_UNITS      equ 256         ; world units per tile
 115  0000              HEIGHT_M        equ 10          ; metres per height unit
 116  0000              HEIGHT_UNITS    equ 128         ; world units per height unit
 117  0000              NEAR            equ 16          ; near clip plane: 1.25 m
 118  0000              VIEW_R          equ 8           ; most draw distance: buildings within +/- 8
 119  0000                                              ; tiles (160 m).  Each level sets its own,
 120  0000                                              ; 2..VIEW_R (view_r; night, fog), and the
 121  0000                                              ; street dots' radius one less (dot_r)
 122  0000              PMAX            equ 24          ; pitch limit (256 = 360 deg) - match gentables.py
 123  0000              SPEED_MAX       equ 28          ; units/frame: 2.2 m/frame, ~31 m/s (110 km/h)
 124  0000              SPEED_MIN       equ -6          ; reverse: 0.47 m/frame, ~6.6 m/s
 125  0000              YAW_RATE        equ $0180       ; turn per frame, 8.8 fixed (1.5 units;
 126  0000                                              ; 256 units = 360 degrees)
 127  0000              YAW_FINE        equ 256*256/360 ; the first frame of a turn: 1 degree
 128  0000                                              ; (182: 0.711 units, 8.8 fixed)
 129  0000              CLIMB_RATE      equ 4           ; units/frame: 0.31 m/frame, ~4.4 m/s
 130  0000              SPEED_STEP      equ 1           ; Q / A: speed change a frame, units/frame
 131  0000                                              ; (1.1 m/s; player.asm uses inc / dec)
 132  0000                      ASSERT SPEED_STEP == 1
 133  0000              ; Air brake (Z): the speed falls by twice the Q / A step every frame, to 0
 134  0000              AIRBRAKE_STEP   equ 2*SPEED_STEP    ; 2 units/frame (2.2 m/s)
 135  0000              ; Booster module (a salvage reward, fitted at once: boost_fitted).  The
 136  0000              ; boost control (K_BOOST, X) puts the speed straight to BOOST_SPEED, twice
 137  0000              ; SPEED_MAX, if going forwards at BOOST_MIN or more with fuel left; again,
 138  0000              ; or out of fuel, puts back the speed it had (boost_spd).  Q, A and Z don't
 139  0000              ; change the speed while boosting.  Each boosted frame burns 1 fuel
 140  0000              ; (boost_fuel, at most BOOST_FUEL_MAX); landed on the pad it refuels 1 a
 141  0000              ; frame (pad_service).  HUD: the B gauge, and the speed bar amber.
 142  0000              BOOST_SPEED     equ 2*SPEED_MAX     ; 56 units/frame
 143  0000              BOOST_MIN       equ SPEED_MAX/2     ; 14: at least half speed, forwards
 144  0000              BOOST_FUEL_MAX  equ 200
 145  0000                      ASSERT BOOST_SPEED < 128 && BOOST_FUEL_MAX < 256
 146  0000              ; Pitch damper: with neither E nor D held, the nose eases back to level.
 147  0000              ; Every PDAMP_FRAMES frames the 8.8 pitch moves towards 0 by
 148  0000              ; max(PDAMP_MIN, |pitch| * PDAMP_K) in 1/256ths of a pitch unit.  With
 149  0000              ; PDAMP_K 0 that is a steady PDAMP_MIN a frame: half a pitch unit, half the
 150  0000              ; rate of the nose keys (1 unit a frame), however far it is from level.  (A
 151  0000              ; PDAMP_K above 0 adds a share of what is left, faster when far off: 43, as
 152  0000              ; it was, returned up to 4 units a frame from full pitch.)
 153  0000              PDAMP_FRAMES    equ 1           ; frames between damping steps
 154  0000              PDAMP_K         equ 0           ; no share: a steady rate
 155  0000              PDAMP_MIN       equ 128         ; 128/256: half a pitch unit a frame
 156  0000              MIN_Y           equ 8           ; lowest flight: 0.6 m
 157  0000              MAX_Y           equ 3*HEIGHT_UNITS/2  ; ceiling 1.5 height units: 15 m
 158  0000              BLD_MAX_H       equ 7*HEIGHT_UNITS  ; tallest building 7.0 height units: 70 m
 159  0000                                              ; (htab level 15, gentables.py; 4.7 m a level)
 160  0000              WORLD_MIN       equ 64
 161  0000              WORLD_MAX       equ GRID*256-64
 162  0000              DMA_SPAN_MIN    equ 20          ; spans this wide or wider are filled by DMA
 163  0000              ; The VTOL (the player's craft): 10 m long by 3 m wide.  Its position
 164  0000              ; (cam_x, cam_z, the camera) is its centre; the hit box against buildings is
 165  0000              ; that rectangle turned to the heading (vtol_ground), and the camera stays
 166  0000              ; COLL_H above any roof under it.
 167  0000              VTOL_LEN_M      equ 10
 168  0000              VTOL_WID_M      equ 3
 169  0000              VTOL_HL         equ VTOL_LEN_M*TILE_UNITS/(TILE_M*2)  ; half length: 64 units

 612  A057                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A057              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A057              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A057              ; them)
   4+ A057              ;
   5+ A057              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A057              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A057              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A057              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A057              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A057              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A057              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A057              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A057              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A057              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A057              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A057              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A057              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A057              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A057              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A057              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A057              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A057              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A057
  24+ A057              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A057              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A057              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A057              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A057              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A057              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A057              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A057              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A057              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A057              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A057              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A057              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A057              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A057              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A057                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A057              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A057              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A057              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A057              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A057              SPEC_IDS        equ 3               ; (how many types)
  44+ A057              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  45+ A057
  46+ A057              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  47+ A057              level_entry:
  48+ A057 21 5B A0             ld hl,level_cur
  49+ A05A C9                   ret
  50+ A05B
  51+ A05B 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  52+ A0CC
# file closed: levels.asm

   2+ A0CC              ; Z-POLICE - text screens (resident): the ULA routines the menu screens
   3+ A0CC              ; (menu.asm) and the load-out screen (loadout.asm) share, from whichever
   4+ A0CC              ; page is in slot 6.  Layer 2 hidden, the ULA screen with opaque paper,
   5+ A0CC              ; 8x8 characters (font8, ASCII 32-95) by row and column with an attribute.

  14+ A0CC              ; paper

  38+ A0FD 23                   inc hl
  39+ A0FE B7                   or a
  40+ A0FF C8                   ret z
  41+ A100 E5                   push hl

  69+ A120 E6 E0                and %11100000
  70+ A122 B3                   or e

  77+ A12B 71                   ld (hl),c

  79+ A12D D1                   pop de

 100+ A146              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 101+ A146              menu_frame:
 102+ A146 CD 51 A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 103+ A149 30 FB                jr nc,.in
 104+ A14B CD 51 A1     .out:   call menu_line                  ; then wait for the next one
 105+ A14E 38 FB                jr c,.out
 106+ A150 C9                   ret
 107+ A151
 108+ A151              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 109+ A151              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 110+ A151              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 111+ A151              menu_line:
 112+ A151 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 113+ A154 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 114+ A156 ED 79                out (c),a
 115+ A158 04                   inc b
 116+ A159 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; high byte
 117+ A15B 05                   dec b
 118+ A15C 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
 119+ A15E ED 79                out (c),a
 120+ A160 04                   inc b
 121+ A161 ED 50                in d,(c)                        ; low byte
 122+ A163 05                   dec b
 123+ A164 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 124+ A166 ED 79                out (c),a
 125+ A168 04                   inc b
 126+ A169 ED 78                in a,(c)
 127+ A16B BB                   cp e
 128+ A16C 20 E3                jr nz,menu_line                 ; torn: again
 129+ A16E E6 01                and 1
 130+ A170 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)
 131+ A171 7A                   ld a,d
 132+ A172 FE C0                cp 192
 133+ A174 C9                   ret

 614  A375                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ A375              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A375              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (resident: the main page, slot 5, always
   3+ A375              ; mapped, so the interrupt routine can read it whatever else is paged in)
   4+ A375              ;
   5+ A375              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ A375              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ A375              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ A375              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ A375              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ A375              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ A375              ;==============================================================================
  12+ A375
  13+ A375              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ A375              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ A375                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ A375                  ENDM
  20+ A375
  21+ A375              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ A375                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ A375                  ENDM
  25+ A375
  26+ A375              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ A375              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ A375              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ A375              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ A375              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ A375                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ A375 ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ A375 ~                    DUP len
  36+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ A375 ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ A375 ~                    EDUP
  42+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ A375                  ENDM
  44+ A375
  45+ A375              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ A375              ; volume v
  47+ A375                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ A375                  ENDM
  50+ A375
  51+ A375              ; The sounds, by number (SFX_*, from 1)

 158+ A498              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 159+ A498              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 160+ A498              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, Bofors 4 x 38 = 152,
 161+ A498              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 162+ A498              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 163+ A498              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the
 164+ A498              ; blast the longer it rumbles, 2 steps (40 ms) per level: 600, 480, 240 and
 165+ A498              ; 160 ms.

  48+ A7FF              ; the ULA screen).  Resident (the main page, with this block), so the city,
  49+ A7FF              ; HUD and menu pages all use it.  It leaves the length's high byte set:
  50+ A7FF              ; fill_spans needs it 0 (clear_screen.spans), so the city page restores it
  51+ A7FF              ; after a fill of its own.
  52+ A7FF              dma_fill:
  53+ A7FF 32 EC A7             ld (l2_cls_byte),a
  54+ A802 22 F9 A7             ld (l2_fill_bstrt),hl
  55+ A805 ED 43 F4 A7          ld (l2_fill_length),bc
  56+ A809 21 ED A7             ld hl,l2_fill
  57+ A80C 06 12                ld b,l2_fill_cmd_len
  58+ A80E 0E 6B                ld c,IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT
  59+ A810 ED B3                otir                            ; CPU waits while the DMA runs
  60+ A812 C9                   ret

 863  AA19
 864  AA19              ;==============================================================================
 865  AA19              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
 866  AA19              ;
 867  AA19              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
 868  AA19              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
 869  AA19              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
 870  AA19              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
 871  AA19              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
 872  AA19              ; becomes the FPS figure.
 873  AA19              ;==============================================================================
 874  AA19                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 875  AA19 ~            vtick:
 876  AA19 ~                    ld bc,$243B
 877  AA19 ~                    ld a,$1E
 878  AA19 ~                    out (c),a
 879  AA19 ~                    inc b
 880  AA19 ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
 881  AA19 ~                    dec b
 882  AA19 ~                    ld a,$1F
 883  AA19 ~                    out (c),a
 884  AA19 ~                    inc b
 885  AA19 ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
 886  AA19 ~                    dec b
 887  AA19 ~                    ld a,$1E
 888  AA19 ~                    out (c),a
 889  AA19 ~                    inc b
 890  AA19 ~                    in a,(c)
 891  AA19 ~                    cp d
 892  AA19 ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
 893  AA19 ~                    and 1
 894  AA19 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
 895  AA19 ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
 896  AA19 ~                    ld (fps_line),de
 897  AA19 ~                    or a
 898  AA19 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
 899  AA19 ~                    ret c
 900  AA19 ~                    ret z
 901  AA19 ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
 902  AA19 ~                    inc (hl)
 903  AA19 ~                    ret
 904  AA19 ~
 905  AA19 ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
 906  AA19 ~            fps_tick:
 907  AA19 ~                    call vtick
 908  AA19 ~                    ld hl,fps_count
 909  AA19 ~                    inc (hl)
 910  AA19 ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
 911  AA19 ~                    cp 50
 912  AA19 ~                    ret c
 913  AA19 ~                    sub 50
 914  AA19 ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
 915  AA19 ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
 916  AA19 ~                    ld (fps_value),a
 917  AA19 ~                    xor a
 918  AA19 ~                    ld (fps_count),a
 919  AA19 ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
 920  AA19                  ENDIF
 921  AA19
 922  AA19              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
 923  AA19              read_nextreg:
 924  AA19 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 925  AA1C ED 79                out (c),a
 926  AA1E 04                   inc b
 927  AA1F ED 78                in a,(c)
 928  AA21 C9                   ret
 929  AA22
 930  AA22              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
 931  AA22              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
 932  AA22              map_shadow:
 933  AA22 3E 13                ld a,$13
 934  AA24 CD 19 AA             call read_nextreg
 935  AA27 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
 936  AA28 32 33 B6             ld (seg_base),a
 937  AA2B C9                   ret
 938  AA2C
 939  AA2C              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
 940  AA2C              l2_flip:
 941  AA2C 3E 12                ld a,$12
 942  AA2E CD 19 AA             call read_nextreg
 943  AA31 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
 944  AA32 3E 13                ld a,$13
 945  AA34 CD 19 AA             call read_nextreg
 946  AA37 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
 947  AA3A 7B                   ld a,e
 948  AA3B ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
 949  AA3E C9                   ret
 950  AA3F
 951  AA3F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 952  AA3F              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
 953  AA3F              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
 954  AA3F              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
 955  AA3F              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
 956  AA3F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 957  AA3F
 958  AA3F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 959  AA3F              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
 960  AA3F              ; SHAKE_LEN).  Each rendered frame, as it is shown, the Layer 2 view is
 961  AA3F              ; offset by the next pair of shake_xy through the scroll registers, a pixel
 962  AA3F              ; or two each way, dying away; the last pair (0, 0) puts it back.  Only
 963  AA3F              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
 964  AA3F              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
 965  AA3F              ; meanwhile.)
 966  AA3F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 967  AA3F              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
 968  AA3F              shake_tick:
 969  AA3F 3A 71 AA             ld a,(shake_t)
 970  AA42 B7                   or a
 971  AA43 C8                   ret z
 972  AA44 3D                   dec a
 973  AA45 32 71 AA             ld (shake_t),a
 974  AA48 87                   add a,a
 975  AA49 21 65 AA             ld hl,shake_xy
 976  AA4C ED 31                add hl,a
 977  AA4E 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 978  AA4F ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
 979  AA52 23                   inc hl
 980  AA53 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 981  AA54 ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
 982  AA57 C9                   ret
 983  AA58
 984  AA58              ; Stop any shake: the view back in place
 985  AA58              shake_off:
 986  AA58 AF                   xor a
 987  AA59 32 71 AA             ld (shake_t),a
 988  AA5C ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0
 989  AA60 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0
 990  AA64 C9                   ret
 991  AA65
 992  AA65              ; (x, y) pixels, used from the last pair back to the first
 993  AA65 00 00 01 00  shake_xy:   db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,192-1, 1,1, 256-2,192-1, 2,1
 993  AA69 FF BF 01 01
 993  AA6D FE BF 02 01
 994  AA71                      ASSERT $ - shake_xy == 2*SHAKE_LEN
 995  AA71 00           shake_t:    db 0                        ; frames of shake left (0: none)
 996  AA72 00           gfx_ok:     db 0                        ; 1: the figures' graphics are loaded
 997  AA73
 998  AA73              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 999  AA73              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
1000  AA73              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1001  AA73              wait_vblank:
1002  AA73 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1003  AA76 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
1004  AA78 ED 79                out (c),a
1005  AA7A 04                   inc b
1006  AA7B ED 78                in a,(c)
1007  AA7D E6 01                and 1
1008  AA7F C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256
1009  AA80 05                   dec b
1010  AA81 3E 1F                ld a,$1F

1116  AB0D              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1117  AB0D              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1118  AB0D              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1119  AB0D              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1120  AB0D              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1121  AB0D              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1122  AB0D              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1123  AB0D              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1124  AB0D              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.
1125  AB0D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1126  AB0D              PAUSE_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1127  AB0D              PAUSE_COL       equ 12

1198  ABF6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1199  ABF6              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1200  ABF6              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1201  ABF6              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1202  ABF6              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1203  ABF6              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1204  ABF6              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), and the booster (fitted, fuel).
1205  ABF6              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1206  ABF6              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1207  ABF6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1208  ABF6              SG_VERSION      equ 1
1209  ABF6              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1210  ABF6 6C AF                dw level
1211  ABF8 01                   db 1
1212  ABF9 75 AF                dw wave_number
1213  ABFB 01                   db 1
1214  ABFC 77 AF                dw salvage_points
1215  ABFE 02                   db 2
1216  ABFF 6F AF                dw vtol_hp
1217  AC01 01                   db 1
1218  AC02 5F AF                dw wpn_slots
1219  AC04 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1220  AC05 69 AF                dw wpn_sel
1221  AC07 01                   db 1
1222  AC08 DE AF                dw wpn_stock
1223  AC0A 09                   db WPN_LAST+1
1224  AC0B E7 AF                dw wpn_unlocked
1225  AC0D 09                   db WPN_LAST+1
1226  AC0E F0 AF                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
1227  AC10 02                   db 2
1228  AC11 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
1229  AC13                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
1230  AC13              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2
1231  AC13
1232  AC13              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game
1233  AC13              sg_copy:
1234  AC13 32 CE AC             ld (sg_dir),a
1235  AC16 DD 21 F6 AB          ld ix,sg_fields
1236  AC1A 11 D5 AC             ld de,sg_buf+5
1237  AC1D DD 6E 00     .lp:    ld l,(ix+0)
1238  AC20 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1239  AC23 7C                   ld a,h
1240  AC24 B5                   or l
1241  AC25 C8                   ret z
1242  AC26 DD 4E 02             ld c,(ix+2)
1243  AC29 06 00                ld b,0
1244  AC2B 3A CE AC             ld a,(sg_dir)
1245  AC2E B7                   or a
1246  AC2F 28 06                jr z,.out
1247  AC31 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; into the game: HL = sg_buf
1248  AC32 ED B0                ldir
1249  AC34 EB                   ex de,hl
1250  AC35 18 02                jr .nx
1251  AC37 ED B0        .out:   ldir                            ; out of it: HL = the field
1252  AC39 01 03 00     .nx:    ld bc,3
1253  AC3C DD 09                add ix,bc
1254  AC3E 18 DD                jr .lp
1255  AC40
1256  AC40              ; Save the game.  Carry set (A = the esxDOS error) if it couldn't be
1257  AC40              ; written.  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.
1258  AC40              save_game:
1259  AC40 21 CA AC             ld hl,sg_magic
1260  AC43 11 D0 AC             ld de,sg_buf
1261  AC46 01 04 00             ld bc,4
1262  AC49 ED B0                ldir
1263  AC4B 3E 01                ld a,SG_VERSION
1264  AC4D 12                   ld (de),a
1265  AC4E AF                   xor a
1266  AC4F CD 13 AC             call sg_copy
1267  AC52 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
1268  AC56 21 B6 AC             ld hl,sg_name
1269  AC59 11 D0 AC             ld de,sg_buf
1270  AC5C 01 29 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
1271  AC5F C3 90 E0             jp fh_save
1272  AC62
1273  AC62              ; Read the save game into sg_buf: carry set if there's none, or it isn't a
1274  AC62              ; save game this version can use (its level out of range too).  Leaves the
1275  AC62              ; file handler in slot 7.
1276  AC62              load_save:
1277  AC62 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
1278  AC66 21 B6 AC             ld hl,sg_name

1280  AC6C 01 29 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
1281  AC6F CD 81 E0             call fh_load
1282  AC72 D8                   ret c
1283  AC73 21 D7 FF             ld hl,-SG_SIZE                  ; all of it?
1284  AC76 09                   add hl,bc
1285  AC77 7C                   ld a,h
1286  AC78 B5                   or l
1287  AC79 20 21                jr nz,.bad
1288  AC7B 21 D0 AC             ld hl,sg_buf
1289  AC7E 11 CA AC             ld de,sg_magic
1290  AC81 06 04                ld b,4
1291  AC83 1A           .m:     ld a,(de)
1292  AC84 BE                   cp (hl)
1293  AC85 20 15                jr nz,.bad
1294  AC87 23                   inc hl
1295  AC88 13                   inc de
1296  AC89 10 F8                djnz .m
1297  AC8B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1298  AC8C FE 01                cp SG_VERSION
1299  AC8E 20 0C                jr nz,.bad
1300  AC90 3A D5 AC             ld a,(sg_buf+5)                 ; its level (sg_fields' first)
1301  AC93 B7                   or a
1302  AC94 28 06                jr z,.bad
1303  AC96 FE 33                cp LEVEL_LAST+1
1304  AC98 30 02                jr nc,.bad
1305  AC9A B7                   or a                            ; usable: carry clear
1306  AC9B C9                   ret
1307  AC9C 37           .bad:   scf
1308  AC9D C9                   ret
1309  AC9E
1310  AC9E              ; CONTINUE (main menu, after load_save): a new game with the save game's
1311  AC9E              ; fields over it, into its level at its wave
1312  AC9E              continue_game:
1313  AC9E 31 39 B7             ld sp,stack_top
1314  ACA1 CD 72 A8             call game_reset
1315  ACA4 3E 01                ld a,1
1316  ACA6 CD 13 AC             call sg_copy

1318  ACAC B7                   or a
1319  ACAD 20 01                jr nz,.w
1320  ACAF 3C                   inc a
1321  ACB0 32 CF AC     .w:     ld (resume_wave),a
1322  ACB3 C3 FA A8             jp next_level
1323  ACB6
1324  ACB6 5A 50 44 41  sg_name:    db "ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS", 0
1324  ACBA 54 41 2F 53
1324  ACBE 41 56 45 47
1324  ACC2 41 4D 45 2E
1324  ACC6 5A 50 53 00
1325  ACCA 5A 50 53 56  sg_magic:   db "ZPSV"
1326  ACCE 00           sg_dir:     db 0
1327  ACCF 01           resume_wave: db 1                       ; next_level's first wave (1, or a
1328  ACD0                                                      ; save game's: continue_game)
1329  ACD0 00 00 00...  sg_buf:     ds SG_SIZE
1330  ACF9
1331  ACF9              ; Z if the VTOL is landed: speed 0 and resting on the floor under it (the
1332  ACF9              ; road, the landing pad or a roof: floor_y), and not a wreck.  Landed, its
1333  ACF9              ; weapons don't fire (update_weapons) and humans can board or get off
1334  ACF9              ; (human_update).
1335  ACF9              vtol_landed:
1336  ACF9 3A 70 AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1337  ACFC B7                   or a
1338  ACFD C0                   ret nz                          ; a wreck
1339  ACFE 3A 5E AF             ld a,(speed)
1340  AD01 B7                   or a
1341  AD02 C0                   ret nz                          ; moving
1342  AD03 CD B7 AA             call floor_y

1344  AD0A B7                   or a
1345  AD0B ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z: resting on it
1346  AD0D C9                   ret
1347  AD0E
1348  AD0E              ; The VTOL's footprint: the corners and the long-side midpoints of its
1349  AD0E              ; VTOL_HL x VTOL_HW (half size) rectangle, turned to the heading, round
1350  AD0E              ; (cam_x, cam_z).  The rectangle is smaller than a tile, so these six points
1351  AD0E              ; find every cell it overlaps (to within a tile corner nicking a long side).
1352  AD0E              ; HL = vg_max = the highest ground under them; Z if all road (0).
1353  AD0E              vtol_ground:
1354  AD0E 3A 5B AF             ld a,(yaw)                      ; forward (sin, cos), right (cos, -sin)
1355  AD11 CD 62 AE             call get_sin
1356  AD14 22 F4 AF             ld (vg_sin),hl
1357  AD17 3A 5B AF             ld a,(yaw)
1358  AD1A C6 40                add a,64
1359  AD1C CD 62 AE             call get_sin
1360  AD1F 22 F6 AF             ld (vg_cos),hl
1361  AD22 EB                   ex de,hl
1362  AD23 21 40 00             ld hl,VTOL_HL
1363  AD26 CD 19 AF             call fmul
1364  AD29 22 FA AF             ld (vg_fz),hl                   ; nose offset z = HL cos
1365  AD2C ED 5B F6 AF          ld de,(vg_cos)
1366  AD30 21 13 00             ld hl,VTOL_HW
1367  AD33 CD 19 AF             call fmul
1368  AD36 22 FC AF             ld (vg_rx),hl                   ; side offset x = HW cos
1369  AD39 ED 5B F4 AF          ld de,(vg_sin)
1370  AD3D 21 40 00             ld hl,VTOL_HL
1371  AD40 CD 19 AF             call fmul
1372  AD43 22 F8 AF             ld (vg_fx),hl                   ; nose offset x = HL sin
1373  AD46 ED 5B F4 AF          ld de,(vg_sin)
1374  AD4A 21 13 00             ld hl,VTOL_HW
1375  AD4D CD 19 AF             call fmul
1376  AD50 CD 0D AF             call neg_hl
1377  AD53 22 FE AF             ld (vg_rz),hl                   ; side offset z = -HW sin
1378  AD56 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1379  AD59 22 00 B0             ld (vg_max),hl
1380  AD5C 2A F8 AF             ld hl,(vg_fx)                   ; nose: the front corners
1381  AD5F ED 5B FA AF          ld de,(vg_fz)
1382  AD63 CD 87 AD             call .side
1383  AD66 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; the long-side midpoints
1384  AD69 11 00 00             ld de,0
1385  AD6C CD 87 AD             call .side
1386  AD6F 2A F8 AF             ld hl,(vg_fx)                   ; tail: the back corners
1387  AD72 CD 0D AF             call neg_hl
1388  AD75 E5                   push hl
1389  AD76 2A FA AF             ld hl,(vg_fz)
1390  AD79 CD 0D AF             call neg_hl
1391  AD7C EB                   ex de,hl
1392  AD7D E1                   pop hl
1393  AD7E CD 87 AD             call .side
1394  AD81 2A 00 B0             ld hl,(vg_max)
1395  AD84 7C                   ld a,h
1396  AD85 B5                   or l
1397  AD86 C9                   ret
1398  AD87              ; HL, DE = an offset along the length (x, z): the points it +- the side offset
1399  AD87 E5           .side:  push hl
1400  AD88 D5                   push de
1401  AD89 ED 4B FC AF          ld bc,(vg_rx)
1402  AD8D 09                   add hl,bc
1403  AD8E EB                   ex de,hl
1404  AD8F ED 4B FE AF          ld bc,(vg_rz)
1405  AD93 09                   add hl,bc
1406  AD94 EB                   ex de,hl
1407  AD95 CD AA AD             call .pt
1408  AD98 D1                   pop de
1409  AD99 E1                   pop hl
1410  AD9A ED 4B FC AF          ld bc,(vg_rx)
1411  AD9E B7                   or a

1608  AF19              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
1609  AF19              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
1610  AF19              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
1611  AF19              fmul:

1621  AF24 94                   sub h

1638  AF39 54                   ld d,h

1654  AF4B 67                   ld h,a

  61+ E100              ; Unrolled span writer: entry = push_end - 1 - pairs (pairs 1..128).  SP is
  62+ E100              ; borrowed (it points into the span), so an interrupt pushes its return
  63+ E100              ; address just below SP: harmless while PUSHes remain, as they overwrite it,
  64+ E100              ; but not after the last one.  So interrupts are off from just before the
  65+ E100              ; last PUSH until SP is back (a few instructions: one arriving meanwhile
  66+ E100              ; waits, as the interrupt line is held far longer).  The routine

 173+ E783              ; IX = (HL << 16) / DE   with HL < DE (unsigned) -> 0.16 fraction
 174+ E783              ; Restoring division, unrolled: each quotient bit goes in inverted, as the
 175+ E783              ; carry (set: the divisor didn't fit), 8 into A, which is complemented:
 176+ E783              ; the high byte, then the low.  Keeps BC.
 177+ E783                  MACRO DIVBIT q
 178+ E783 ~                    add hl,hl
 179+ E783 ~                    jr c,$+9                        ; (17-bit remainder: it fits)
 180+ E783 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; (carry clear)
 181+ E783 ~                    jr nc,$+9                       ; fits: bit 1 (carry clear)
 182+ E783 ~                    add hl,de                       ; doesn't: put it back (carry set)
 183+ E783 ~                    jr $+6
 184+ E783 ~                    or a                            ; (from the jr c)
 185+ E783 ~                    sbc hl,de
 186+ E783 ~                    or a                            ; bit 1
 187+ E783 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)
 188+ E783                  ENDM

 219+ E81C              ;==============================================================================
 220+ E81C              ; Perspective projection
 221+ E81C              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 222+ E81C              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 223+ E81C              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 224+ E81C              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 225+ E81C              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 226+ E81C              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.

 509+ E9DA 7C                   ld a,h
 510+ E9DB F5                   push af
 511+ E9DC CD FD E9             call scomp16
 512+ E9DF F1                   pop af
 513+ E9E0 17                   rla
 514+ E9E1 DC 0D AF             call c,neg_hl

 516+ E9E5 19                   add hl,de

 518+ E9E7 7C                   ld a,h
 519+ E9E8 B7                   or a
 520+ E9E9 28 05                jr z,.z

 523+ E9F0 78           .z:     ld a,b
 524+ E9F1 BD                   cp l

 528+ E9F8 B1                   or c

 531+ E9FD
 532+ E9FD              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 533+ E9FD              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 534+ E9FD              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 535+ E9FD              scomp16:
 536+ E9FD CD 14 AF             call abs_hl
 537+ EA00 3A D1 EA             ld a,(scale_comp.sh+1)

 541+ EA07 FA 10 EA             jp m,.l

 544+ EA0D EB                   ex de,hl
 545+ EA0E 18 06                jr .sd

 549+ EA15 EB                   ex de,hl
 550+ EA16 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 551+ EA17 FE 04                cp 4

 553+ EA1B 21 FF 03             ld hl,1023                      ; (rounding at the guard band's edge)
 554+ EA1E 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bits 8-9 of Xn
 555+ EA1F 3A ED EA             ld a,(scale_comp.rl+1)
 556+ EA22 5F                   ld e,a
 557+ EA23 55                   ld d,l
 558+ EA24 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 559+ EA26 4A                   ld c,d
 560+ EA27 3A F3 EA             ld a,(scale_comp.rh+1)
 561+ EA2A 5F                   ld e,a
 562+ EA2B 55                   ld d,l
 563+ EA2C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh

 565+ EA2F 83                   add a,e
 566+ EA30 6F                   ld l,a
 567+ EA31 7A                   ld a,d
 568+ EA32 CE 00                adc a,0
 569+ EA34 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 570+ EA35 0E 00                ld c,0
 571+ EA37 78                   ld a,b
 572+ EA38 B7                   or a
 573+ EA39 28 0A                jr z,.nh

 575+ EA3F 19           .ad:    add hl,de                       ; + (256 * Xh * R) >> 8
 576+ EA40 30 01                jr nc,.a1
 577+ EA42 0C                   inc c
 578+ EA43 10 FA        .a1:    djnz .ad
 579+ EA45 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 580+ EA46 20 01                jr nz,.nr

 582+ EA49 6C           .nr:    ld l,h
 583+ EA4A 61                   ld h,c
 584+ EA4B CB 3C                srl h
 585+ EA4D CB 1D                rr l                            ; HL = (C:H) >> 1 = P >> 9
 586+ EA4F C9                   ret
 587+ EA50
 588+ EA50              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 589+ EA50              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 590+ EA50              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 591+ EA50              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 592+ EA50              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 593+ EA50              c2_isect:
 594+ EA50 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 595+ EA53 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 596+ EA57 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 597+ EA5A 17                   rla
 598+ EA5B 30 01                jr nc,.sin
 599+ EA5D EB                   ex de,hl                        ; S outside: E is the inside end
 600+ EA5E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 601+ EA61 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 602+ EA63 ED 31                add hl,a
 603+ EA65 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 604+ EA66 23                   inc hl
 605+ EA67 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 606+ EA68 EB                   ex de,hl
 607+ EA69 ED 31                add hl,a
 608+ EA6B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 609+ EA6C 23                   inc hl
 610+ EA6D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 611+ EA6E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 612+ EA6F B7                   or a
 613+ EA70 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 614+ EA72 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 615+ EA74 C5                   push bc
 616+ EA75 E5                   push hl
 617+ EA76 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 618+ EA79 CD 14 AF             call abs_hl
 619+ EA7C EB                   ex de,hl
 620+ EA7D 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 621+ EA80 CD 14 AF             call abs_hl

 623+ EA84 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |dS| + |dE|

 626+ EA8A 28 03                jr z,.di
 627+ EA8C 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 628+ EA8F CD 83 E7     .di:    call div_frac                   ; t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|)
 629+ EA92 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in

 631+ EA95 D1                   pop de
 632+ EA96 CD 50 E7             call mul_frac
 633+ EA99 C1                   pop bc
 634+ EA9A 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 635+ EA9B 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 636+ EA9E B7                   or a
 637+ EA9F 20 12                jr nz,.y
 638+ EAA1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 639+ EAA4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 640+ EAA7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 641+ EAAA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 642+ EAAD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 643+ EAB1 18 10                jr .f
 644+ EAB3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 645+ EAB6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 646+ EAB9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 647+ EABC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 648+ EABF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 649+ EAC3 C3 3F ED     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 650+ EAC6                  ENDIF

 652+ EAC6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 653+ EAC6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by project.
 654+ EAC6              scale_comp:

 664+ EAD0 3E 00        .sh:    ld a,0
 665+ EAD2 B7                   or a
 666+ EAD3 28 10                jr z,.sd
 667+ EAD5 EB                   ex de,hl
 668+ EAD6 FA DF EA             jp m,.l
 669+ EAD9 47                   ld b,a
 670+ EADA ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 671+ EADC EB                   ex de,hl
 672+ EADD 18 06                jr .sd
 673+ EADF ED 44        .l:     neg
 674+ EAE1 47                   ld b,a
 675+ EAE2 ED 28                bsla de,b
 676+ EAE4 EB                   ex de,hl

 701+ EB09 20 01                jr nz,.nr

 711+ EB16              ;==============================================================================
 712+ EB16              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 713+ EB16              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 714+ EB16              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 715+ EB16              ;==============================================================================
 716+ EB16              calc_oc:

 719+ EB18 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = X

 768+ EB5F                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 769+ EB5F              ; plane_dist for a 2D plane (clip2d): IX -> 2D vertex -> HL = its distance
 770+ EB5F              ; inside c2_off / c2_hi (>= 0: inside)
 771+ EB5F              c2_dist:

 791+ EB78              ; Signed distance of vertex IX to clip plane (clip_plane bit). >= 0 is inside.
 792+ EB78              plane_dist:

 829+ EBB9
 830+ EBB9              ;==============================================================================
 831+ EBB9              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 832+ EBB9              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 833+ EBB9              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 834+ EBB9              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 835+ EBB9              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 836+ EBB9              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 837+ EBB9              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.
 838+ EBB9              ;==============================================================================
 839+ EBB9              clip_poly:
 840+ EBB9 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 841+ EBBC 3D                   dec a
 842+ EBBD 87                   add a,a
 843+ EBBE 87                   add a,a
 844+ EBBF 87                   add a,a

 849+ EBC9 DD E1                pop ix

 852+ EBD1 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 853+ EBD4 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl

 856+ EBDC 32 C7 E0             ld (clip_on),a
 857+ EBDF 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 858+ EBE2 32 C8 E0             ld (clip_cnt),a
 859+ EBE5 DD 2A D0 E0  .loop:  ld ix,(clip_e)

 866+ EBF8 28 0D                jr z,.ein

 873+ EC0A FD E5                push iy                         ; (LDI: 16 T a byte)

 876+ EC0D ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC0F ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC11 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC13 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC15 ED A0       >        ldi

 882+ EC24 18 0E                jr .next
 883+ EC26 3A D3 E0     .eout:  ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 884+ EC29 CB 7F                bit 7,a
 885+ EC2B 20 07                jr nz,.next

 887+ EC2D AF                   xor a
 888+ EC2E 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 889+ EC31 CD 62 EC             call clip_isect

 891+ EC37 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 892+ EC3A 11 08 00             ld de,8
 893+ EC3D 19                   add hl,de
 894+ EC3E 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 895+ EC41 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 896+ EC44 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 897+ EC47 21 C8 E0             ld hl,clip_cnt

 899+ EC4B 20 98                jr nz,.loop
 900+ EC4D 3A C7 E0             ld a,(clip_on)
 901+ EC50 32 C6 E0             ld (clip_n),a
 902+ EC53 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)                ; the output is the next pass's input
 903+ EC56 ED 5B CC E0          ld de,(clip_dst)
 904+ EC5A ED 53 CA E0          ld (clip_src),de
 905+ EC5E 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 906+ EC61 C9                   ret
 907+ EC62
 908+ EC62              ; Output S + t*(E-S) at IY, t = dS/(dS-dE)
 909+ EC62              clip_isect:

 911+ EC62 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 912+ EC65 17                   rla
 913+ EC66 DA 50 EA             jp c,c2_isect                   ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 914+ EC69                  ENDIF
 915+ EC69                  IFDEF LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 916+ EC69                      ; Level flight: a vertical building edge (S and E share X and Z)
 917+ EC69                      ; meets the top or bottom plane at (X, +-0.5Z, Z) - no divide or
 918+ EC69                      ; interpolation.  At pitch 0 vertical edges can't cross the near or
 919+ EC69                      ; side planes, so this covers every plane they do cross.
 920+ EC69 3A 5D AF             ld a,(pitch)
 921+ EC6C B7                   or a
 922+ EC6D 20 49                jr nz,.gen

 924+ EC72 FE 08                cp 8
 925+ EC74 38 42                jr c,.gen                       ; not top or bottom

 936+ EC87 23                   inc hl
 937+ EC88 23                   inc hl
 938+ EC89 23                   inc hl

 940+ EC8B 13                   inc de

 952+ EC9E FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 953+ ECA1 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 954+ ECA4 FD 77 01             ld (iy+1),a

 960+ ECB6 18 6D                jr .ty                          ; Y = +-0.5Z
 961+ ECB8              .gen:
 962+ ECB8                  ENDIF
 963+ ECB8 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 964+ ECBB CD 14 AF             call abs_hl
 965+ ECBE 22 D7 E0             ld (ci_a),hl
 966+ ECC1 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 967+ ECC4 CD 14 AF             call abs_hl
 968+ ECC7 ED 5B D7 E0          ld de,(ci_a)
 969+ ECCB 19                   add hl,de
 970+ ECCC EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = |dS|+|dE|, HL = |dS|

1254+ EF38              ;==============================================================================
1255+ EF38              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1256+ EF38              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1257+ EF38              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1258+ EF38              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1259+ EF38              ;   Winding doesn't matter.

1330+ EFAB              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.
