1343+ EFB9 DD 6F                ld ixl,a                        ; steep: q = 0, r = dx
1344+ EFBB CD 2D F0             call .setup
1345+ EFBE 18 20                jr .p0s
1346+ EFC0 CD 0B E8     .pdv:   call div8                       ; E = q, A = r
1347+ EFC3 DD 63                ld ixh,e
1348+ EFC5 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1349+ EFC7 CD 2D F0             call .setup
1350+ EFCA DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1351+ EFCC B7                   or a
1352+ EFCD 28 11                jr z,.p0s
1353+ EFCF 72           .pl:    ld (hl),d
1354+ EFD0 2C                   inc l
1355+ EFD1 7A                   ld a,d
1356+ EFD2 DD 84                add a,ixh
1357+ EFD4 57                   ld d,a
1358+ EFD5 7B                   ld a,e
1359+ EFD6 DD 85                add a,ixl
1360+ EFD8 30 02                jr nc,.pl1
1361+ EFDA 81                   add a,c
1362+ EFDB 14                   inc d
1363+ EFDC 5F           .pl1:   ld e,a
1364+ EFDD 10 F0                djnz .pl
1365+ EFDF C9                   ret
1366+ EFE0              ; (no x step: the accumulator kept in A and the remainder in E, not IXL)
1367+ EFE0 7B           .p0s:   ld a,e
1368+ EFE1 DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1369+ EFE3 72           .p0:    ld (hl),d
1370+ EFE4 2C                   inc l
1371+ EFE5 83                   add a,e
1372+ EFE6 30 02                jr nc,.p01
1373+ EFE8 81                   add a,c
1374+ EFE9 14                   inc d
1375+ EFEA 10 F7        .p01:   djnz .p0
1376+ EFEC C9                   ret
1377+ EFED
1378+ EFED ED 44        .neg:   neg
1379+ EFEF B9                   cp c
1380+ EFF0 30 07                jr nc,.ndv
1381+ EFF2 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1382+ EFF4 CD 2D F0             call .setup
1383+ EFF7 18 20                jr .n0s
1384+ EFF9 CD 0B E8     .ndv:   call div8
1385+ EFFC DD 63                ld ixh,e
1386+ EFFE DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1387+ F000 CD 2D F0             call .setup
1388+ F003 DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1389+ F005 B7                   or a
1390+ F006 28 11                jr z,.n0s
1391+ F008 72           .nl:    ld (hl),d
1392+ F009 2C                   inc l
1393+ F00A 7A                   ld a,d
1394+ F00B DD 94                sub ixh
1395+ F00D 57                   ld d,a
1396+ F00E 7B                   ld a,e
1397+ F00F DD 85                add a,ixl
1398+ F011 30 02                jr nc,.nl1
1399+ F013 81                   add a,c
1400+ F014 15                   dec d
1401+ F015 5F           .nl1:   ld e,a
1402+ F016 10 F0                djnz .nl
1403+ F018 C9                   ret
1404+ F019 7B           .n0s:   ld a,e
1405+ F01A DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1406+ F01C 72           .n0:    ld (hl),d
1407+ F01D 2C                   inc l
1408+ F01E 83                   add a,e
1409+ F01F 30 02                jr nc,.n01
1410+ F021 81                   add a,c
1411+ F022 15                   dec d
1412+ F023 10 F7        .n01:   djnz .n0
1413+ F025 C9                   ret
1414+ F026
1415+ F026              ; A vertical edge: the same x on every row (as the steep walk gives it with
1416+ F026              ; no x step: exactly)
1417+ F026 41           .vert:  ld b,c
1418+ F027 04                   inc b                           ; dy+1 rows
1419+ F028 72           .vl:    ld (hl),d
1420+ F029 2C                   inc l
1421+ F02A 10 FC                djnz .vl
1422+ F02C C9                   ret
1423+ F02D
1424+ F02D              ; B = dy+1 rows, E = biased accumulator (dy/2 - dy), C = -dy
1425+ F02D 41           .setup: ld b,c
1426+ F02E 04                   inc b
1427+ F02F 79                   ld a,c
1428+ F030 CB 3F                srl a
1429+ F032 91                   sub c
1430+ F033 5F                   ld e,a
1431+ F034 79                   ld a,c
1432+ F035 ED 44                neg
1433+ F037 4F                   ld c,a
1434+ F038 C9                   ret
1435+ F039
1436+ F039              ;==============================================================================
1437+ F039              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1438+ F039              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1439+ F039              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1440+ F039              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1441+ F039              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1442+ F039              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1443+ F039              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1444+ F039              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1445+ F039              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1446+ F039              ;==============================================================================
1447+ F039              fill_spans:
1448+ F039 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1449+ F03C CD 20 E7             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1450+ F03F FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1451+ F043 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1452+ F045 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1453+ F048 47                   ld b,a
1454+ F049 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1455+ F04C 90                   sub b
1456+ F04D 3C                   inc a
1457+ F04E DD 67                ld ixh,a                        ; rows to fill
1458+ F050 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)                      ; the middle row: which table is left?
1459+ F053 80                   add a,b
1460+ F054 1F                   rra
1461+ F055 6F                   ld l,a
1462+ F056 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1463+ F058 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1464+ F059 24                   inc h
1465+ F05A BE                   cp (hl)
1466+ F05B 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1467+ F05D 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1468+ F05F 38 04                jr c,.ta
1469+ F061 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1470+ F063 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1471+ F065 32 6D F0     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1472+ F068 79                   ld a,c
1473+ F069 32 70 F0             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1474+ F06C
1475+ F06C              fs_loop:
1476+ F06C 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1477+ F06E 68                   ld l,b
1478+ F06F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1479+ F070 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1480+ F071 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1481+ F072 B9                   cp c
1482+ F073 38 03                jr c,.ord
1483+ F075 69                   ld l,c
1484+ F076 4F                   ld c,a
1485+ F077 7D                   ld a,l
1486+ F078 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1487+ F079 78                   ld a,b
1488+ F07A E6 1F                and 31
1489+ F07C 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1490+ F07D 79                   ld a,c
1491+ F07E 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1492+ F07F FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1493+ F081 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1494+ F083 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1495+ F085 38 07                jr c,.even
1496+ F087 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1497+ F088 B7                   or a
1498+ F089 CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1499+ F08C 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1500+ F08E 3C           .even:  inc a
1501+ F08F 69           .go:    ld l,c
1502+ F090 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1503+ F091 F9                   ld sp,hl
1504+ F092 6F                   ld l,a
1505+ F093 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1506+ F095 95                   sub l
1507+ F096 6F                   ld l,a
1508+ F097 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1509+ F099 E9                   jp (hl)
1510+ F09A                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1511+ F09A
1512+ F09A                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1513+ F09A                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1514+ F09A 3C           .dma:   inc a
1515+ F09B 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1516+ F09D 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1517+ F09E 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1518+ F0A0              .dmal:
1519+ F0A0 4F                   ld c,a
1520+ F0A1 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1521+ F0A3 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1522+ F0A5 79                   ld a,c
1523+ F0A6 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1524+ F0A8 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1525+ F0AA D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1526+ F0AC 7D                   ld a,l
1527+ F0AD D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1528+ F0AF 7C                   ld a,h
1529+ F0B0 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1530+ F0B2 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1531+ F0B4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1532+ F0B6 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1533+ F0B8 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1534+ F0BA 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1535+ F0BB DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1536+ F0BD C8                   ret z
1537+ F0BE 78                   ld a,b
1538+ F0BF E6 1F                and 31
1539+ F0C1 C2 6C F0             jp nz,fs_loop
1540+ F0C4 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1541+ F0C7                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1
1542+ F0C7
1543+ F0C7              ;==============================================================================
1544+ F0C7              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1545+ F0C7              ;==============================================================================
1546+ F0C7              outline_poly:
1547+ F0C7 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1548+ F0CB 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1549+ F0CE 47                   ld b,a
1550+ F0CF C5           .lp:    push bc
1551+ F0D0 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1552+ F0D3 B7                   or a
1553+ F0D4 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1554+ F0D6 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1555+ F0D9 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1556+ F0DC DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1557+ F0DF DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)
1558+ F0E2 CD EE F0             call draw_line
1559+ F0E5 01 04 00     .sk:    ld bc,4
1560+ F0E8 DD 09                add ix,bc
1561+ F0EA C1                   pop bc
1562+ F0EB 10 E2                djnz .lp
1563+ F0ED C9                   ret
1564+ F0EE
1565+ F0EE              ;==============================================================================
1566+ F0EE              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1567+ F0EE              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1568+ F0EE              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1569+ F0EE              ;==============================================================================
1570+ F0EE              draw_line:

1572+ F0F1 4F                   ld c,a
1573+ F0F2 7B                   ld a,e
1574+ F0F3 95                   sub l

1578+ F0FA 18 02                jr .xd
1579+ F0FC 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1580+ F0FE 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1581+ F0FF 78                   ld a,b
1582+ F100 32 28 F1             ld (.smx1),a
1583+ F103 32 45 F1             ld (.smx2),a

1585+ F107 94                   sub h

1587+ F10A ED 44                neg
1588+ F10C 06 25                ld b,OP_DEC_H
1589+ F10E 18 02                jr .yd
1590+ F110 06 24        .yp:    ld b,OP_INC_H
1591+ F112 57           .yd:    ld d,a                          ; |dy|
1592+ F113 78                   ld a,b
1593+ F114 32 2C F1             ld (.smy1),a

1595+ F11A 7C                   ld a,h
1596+ F11B CD 20 E7             call seg_map                    ; page in the start row's section
1597+ F11E 67                   ld h,a                          ; y within the section
1598+ F11F 7B                   ld a,e
1599+ F120 BA                   cp d
1600+ F121 38 13                jr c,.ymaj
1601+ F123 43                   ld b,e
1602+ F124 04                   inc b
1603+ F125 CB 3F                srl a
1604+ F127 71           .xl:    ld (hl),c
1605+ F128 2C           .smx1:  inc l
1606+ F129 92                   sub d
1607+ F12A 30 07                jr nc,.xs
1608+ F12C 24           .smy1:  inc h
1609+ F12D CB 6C                bit 5,h                         ; left the 32-row section?
1610+ F12F C4 37 E7             call nz,line_seg
1611+ F132 83                   add a,e
1612+ F133 10 F2        .xs:    djnz .xl
1613+ F135 C9                   ret
1614+ F136 42           .ymaj:  ld b,d
1615+ F137 04                   inc b
1616+ F138 7A                   ld a,d
1617+ F139 CB 3F                srl a
1618+ F13B 71           .yl:    ld (hl),c
1619+ F13C 24           .smy2:  inc h
1620+ F13D CB 6C                bit 5,h
1621+ F13F C4 37 E7             call nz,line_seg
1622+ F142 93                   sub e
1623+ F143 30 02                jr nc,.ys
1624+ F145 2C           .smx2:  inc l
1625+ F146 82                   add a,d
1626+ F147 10 F2        .ys:    djnz .yl
1627+ F149 C9                   ret
1628+ F14A
1629+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1630+ F14A              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1631+ F14A              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1632+ F14A              ; row, ground below.  The fills are dma_fill's (layer2_cls.asm, resident),
1633+ F14A              ; the l2_fill command block with its destination (port B) and length; the source
1634+ F14A              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1635+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1636+ F14A              clear_screen:
1637+ F14A 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; C = first row of the section
1638+ F14C 79           .sec:   ld a,c
1639+ F14D CD 20 E7             call seg_map
1640+ F150 3A 0C B6             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows here = clamp(hz - C, 0, 32)
1641+ F153                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1642+ F153 3C                   inc a                           ; the horizon row too: at the horizon
1643+ F154                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1644+ F154                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1645+ F154                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1646+ F154                  ENDIF
1647+ F154 91                   sub c
1648+ F155 30 01                jr nc,.s1
1649+ F157 AF                   xor a
1650+ F158 FE 21        .s1:    cp 33
1651+ F15A 38 02                jr c,.s2
1652+ F15C 3E 20                ld a,32
1653+ F15E 32 EE E0     .s2:    ld (cs_sky),a
1654+ F161 B7                   or a
1655+ F162 28 0D                jr z,.gnd
1656+ F164 C5                   push bc
1657+ F165 47                   ld b,a                          ; sky: section start, rows*256 bytes
1658+ F166 0E 00                ld c,0
1659+ F168 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1660+ F16B                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1661+ F16B 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE   ; "sky" is the perimeter wall
1662+ F16D                  ELSE
1663+ F16D ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1664+ F16D                  ENDIF
1665+ F16D CD FF A7             call dma_fill
1666+ F170 C1                   pop bc
1667+ F171 3A EE E0     .gnd:   ld a,(cs_sky)
1668+ F174 FE 20                cp 32
1669+ F176 28 11                jr z,.nx
1670+ F178 C5                   push bc
1671+ F179 67                   ld h,a                          ; ground: after the sky rows
1672+ F17A 2E 00                ld l,0
1673+ F17C ED 44                neg
1674+ F17E C6 20                add a,32
1675+ F180 47                   ld b,a
1676+ F181 0E 00                ld c,0
1677+ F183 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1678+ F185 CD FF A7             call dma_fill
1679+ F188 C1                   pop bc
1680+ F189 79           .nx:    ld a,c
1681+ F18A C6 20                add a,32
1682+ F18C 4F                   ld c,a
1683+ F18D FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1684+ F18F 20 BB                jr nz,.sec
1685+ F191                      ; Leave the DMA ready for fill_spans: length high byte 0, so each span
1686+ F191                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1687+ F191                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.
1688+ F191 3E 45        .spans: ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_HI
1689+ F193 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1690+ F195 AF                   xor a
1691+ F196 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1692+ F198 C9                   ret

1695+ F199              ;==============================================================================
1696+ F199              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
1697+ F199              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
1698+ F199              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
1699+ F199              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
1700+ F199              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
1701+ F199              ;==============================================================================
1702+ F199              draw_city:
1703+ F199                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1704+ F199 CD 9F 83             call occ_begin
1705+ F19C 3A E9 F7             ld a,(occ_on)
1706+ F19F B7                   or a
1707+ F1A0 28 13                jr z,draw_cells                 ; pitched: the painter's order as is
1708+ F1A2 CD D7 83             call occ_cells                  ; front to back: keep what isn't hidden
1709+ F1A5 3A EA F7             ld a,(occ_full)
1710+ F1A8 B7                   or a
1711+ F1A9 CA B8 87             jp z,occ_draw_list              ; back to front: draw it
1712+ F1AC AF                   xor a                           ; too many to keep: draw this frame
1713+ F1AD 32 E9 F7             ld (occ_on),a                   ; the plain way
1714+ F1B0 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H
1715+ F1B2 32 1D F8             ld (bld_cut),a                  ; (and nothing cut)
1716+ F1B5                  ENDIF
1717+ F1B5              draw_cells:

1719+ F1B8 21 6D AF             ld hl,view_r
1720+ F1BB 96                   sub (hl)
1721+ F1BC 32 CA F7             ld (cell_j),a

1723+ F1C2 21 32 B6             ld hl,cz
1724+ F1C5 BE                   cp (hl)
1725+ F1C6 28 09                jr z,.f
1726+ F1C8 CD ED F1             call draw_row

1728+ F1CE 34                   inc (hl)
1729+ F1CF 18 EE                jr .b

1731+ F1D4 21 6D AF             ld hl,view_r

1735+ F1DE 21 32 B6             ld hl,cz
1736+ F1E1 BE                   cp (hl)
1737+ F1E2 28 09                jr z,draw_row                   ; camera row last
1738+ F1E4 CD ED F1             call draw_row

1740+ F1EA 35                   dec (hl)
1741+ F1EB 18 EE                jr .f2

1745+ F1F0 FE 40                cp GRID

 499+ 839F
 500+ 839F                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 501+ 839F              ;==============================================================================
 502+ 839F              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL, level flight only)
 503+ 839F              ;
 504+ 839F              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 505+ 839F              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 506+ 839F              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 507+ 839F              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 508+ 839F              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 509+ 839F              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 510+ 839F              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 511+ 839F              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 512+ 839F              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 513+ 839F              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 514+ 839F              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 515+ 839F              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 516+ 839F              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 517+ 839F              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 518+ 839F              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 519+ 839F              ;==============================================================================
 520+ 839F              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 521+ 839F              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 522+ 839F                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 523+ 839F                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 524+ 839F                                              ; columns at once
 525+ 839F              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 526+ 839F              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 527+ 839F              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 528+ 839F                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 529+ 839F                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 530+ 839F                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 531+ 839F              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 532+ 839F              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 533+ 839F              ; corner's spare bytes

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------
  39+ E000              KB_SHIFT    equ $0001                   ; bank 0: $FEFE
  40+ E000              KB_Z        equ $0002

 146+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 147+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 148+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 149+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 150+ E000              kbd_scan:
 151+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 152+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 153+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 154+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 155+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 156+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 157+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 158+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 159+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 160+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 161+ E017 23                   inc hl
 162+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 163+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
 164+ E01C 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; banks 8, 9: NextRegs $B0, $B1
 165+ E01F 3E B0                ld a,$B0
 166+ E021 ED 79                out (c),a
 167+ E023 04                   inc b
 168+ E024 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; already 1 = pressed
 169+ E026 77                   ld (hl),a
 170+ E027 23                   inc hl
 171+ E028 05                   dec b
 172+ E029 3E B1                ld a,$B1
 173+ E02B ED 79                out (c),a
 174+ E02D 04                   inc b
 175+ E02E ED 78                in a,(c)
 176+ E030 77                   ld (hl),a
 177+ E031 23                   inc hl
 178+ E032                      ; banks 10-12, the joysticks: only the ports a joystick is set to
 179+ E032                      ; (NextReg $05), so an unused port can't read as all pressed
 180+ E032 05                   dec b                           ; (BC = $243B)
 181+ E033 3E 05                ld a,$05
 182+ E035 ED 79                out (c),a
 183+ E037 04                   inc b
 184+ E038 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; the joystick modes
 185+ E03A 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 1: bits 7-6, and bit 3
 186+ E03B 07                   rlca

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 32          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 20                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 20                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret
 112+ E043
 113+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 114+ E043              ; Load B 8-bit patterns (256 bytes each) from HL into pattern memory, from
 115+ E043              ; pattern A (0..63).  HL ends past them.
 116+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 117+ E043              spr_patterns:

 119+ E044 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 120+ E047 ED 79                out (c),a

 123+ E04D ED B3                otir
 124+ E04F 15                   dec d
 125+ E050 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 126+ E052 C9                   ret
 127+ E053
 128+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E053              ; Load B colours (8-bit RRRGGGBB) from HL into the sprite palette, from
 130+ E053              ; index A.  (It starts as the identity: only needed for other colours.)
 131+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 134+ E057 ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a

 138+ E05F 10 F9                djnz .lp
 139+ E061 C9                   ret

 141+ E062              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.
 144+ E062              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 145+ E062              spr_set:

 179+ E091 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 180+ E092 E6 FE                and $FE

 182+ E095 77                   ld (hl),a

 184+ E097 23                   inc hl

 188+ E09C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 189+ E09D E6 FE                and $FE
 190+ E09F B2                   or d

 200+ E0A9 7E                   ld a,(hl)

 203+ E0AD 77                   ld (hl),a

 216+ E0BB B3                   or e

 220+ E0BE              ; Sprite A: scale E across, D down (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8)
 221+ E0BE              spr_scale:

 223+ E0BF CD FA E0             call spr_addr
 224+ E0C2 D1                   pop de

 227+ E0C6 6F                   ld l,a
 228+ E0C7 7B                   ld a,e

 230+ E0CA 07                   rlca
 231+ E0CB 07                   rlca
 232+ E0CC 5F                   ld e,a
 233+ E0CD 7A                   ld a,d
 234+ E0CE E6 03                and 3
 235+ E0D0 B3                   or e

 244+ E0D9              ; Sprite A: hide / show

 248+ E0DE C9                   ret
 249+ E0DF              spr_show:

 252+ E0E4 C9                   ret

 255+ E0E5              spr_hide_all:

 257+ E0E8 11 05 00             ld de,SPR_ATTR
 258+ E0EB 06 20                ld b,SPR_COUNT

 260+ E0EF 19                   add hl,de
 261+ E0F0 10 FB                djnz .lp
 262+ E0F2 C9                   ret

 264+ E0F3              ; A = sprite -> HL -> its attributes in the table, +3 for spr_addr3.
 265+ E0F3              ; (The table doesn't cross a 256-byte boundary, so +n is just L + n.)
 266+ E0F3              spr_addr3:
 267+ E0F3 CD FA E0             call spr_addr

 269+ E0F7 23                   inc hl
 270+ E0F8 23                   inc hl

 276+ E0FF 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow

 281+ E104              ; Sprite data
 282+ E104              ;==============================================================================
 283+ E104              ; The patterns themselves are in the sprite banks (sprite_data.asm).

 286+ E104              ;   HSPR_FIELD   0  waiting in the field, not yet rescued: an empty square

  17+ E2A9              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
  18+ E2A9              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
  19+ E2A9              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
  20+ E2A9              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
  21+ E2A9              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
  22+ E2A9              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,

  24+ E2A9              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks

  35+ E2A9                                                  ; this + 2 * (COMP_HALF + mark - yaw)

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:
  15+ E000 ED 91 07 03          nextreg $07,3                   ; 28MHz
  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites
  19+ E010                                                      ; off until sprites_init
  20+ E010 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
  21+ E014 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
  22+ E018 ED 91 1C 01          nextreg $1C,%00000001           ; reset L2 clip index
  23+ E01C ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; Layer 2 clip: x 0..255,
  24+ E020 ED 91 18 FF          nextreg $18,255
  25+ E024 ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; y 0..191: the viewport, and the
  26+ E028 ED 91 18 BF          nextreg $18,191                 ; city map through the ULA panel
  27+ E02C ED 91 54 0A          nextreg ULA_MMU,PAGE_ULA0       ; ULA screen (bank 5) at $8000
  28+ E030 ED 91 51 05          nextreg ZOMBIE_MMU,PAGE_ZOMBIE  ; zombie code/data stays at $2000
  29+ E034 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0       ; occlusion data at $4000-$5FFF,
  30+ E038 ED 91 53 07          nextreg TABLES_MMU,PAGE_OCC1    ; city_col at $6000-$6FFF
  31+ E03C                      ; Peripheral settings.  $06 and $08 are read, changed and written
  32+ E03C                      ; back, so the bits not named here keep their values (in $06, bit 4
  33+ E03C                      ; is the divMMC automap, which the file handler's RST $08 needs).

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name

  56+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  57+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only

  66+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position

  74+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  75+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).

   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08) and the AY
   8+ E000              ; outputs to stereo (NextReg $09).  init_audio then sets every chip to a
   9+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_clear).
  10+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  11+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  12+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  13+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  14+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  15+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  16+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).

  19+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  20+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;

  22+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register

  79+ E000              SFX_BOFORS      equ 6               ; the Bofors / proximity cannon: one shell

  81+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  82+ E000              SFX_BOOM_BOFORS equ 9               ;   a Bofors shell's,
  83+ E000              SFX_BOOM_PROX   equ 10              ;   a proximity shell's
  84+ E000              SFX_SPLAT       equ 11              ; a zombie hit (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  85+ E000              SFX_CRASH       equ 12              ; the VTOL hitting a building (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  86+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)
  87+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 13              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
  88+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
  89+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
  90+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  91+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
  92+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  93+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
  94+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  95+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
  96+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_A  equ AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  97+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A tone only
  98+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  99+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
 100+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
 101+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 102+ E000
 103+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 104+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 105+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 106+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 107+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 108+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 109+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 110+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 111+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 112+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 113+ E000
 114+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 116+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 117+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.
 118+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 119+ E000              init_audio:
 120+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; the engines off first: the interrupt
 121+ E001 32 66 3A             ld (eng_on),a                   ; leaves the AYs alone (interrupts.asm)
 122+ E004 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a                  ; and no sound effect asked for or
 123+ E007 32 6A 3A             ld (sfx2_req),a                 ; playing, on any voice
 124+ E00A 32 6D 3A             ld (sfx3_req),a
 125+ E00D 67                   ld h,a
 126+ E00E 6F                   ld l,a
 127+ E00F 22 68 3A             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 128+ E012 22 6B 3A             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 129+ E015 22 6E 3A             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 130+ E018 3E 01                ld a,AY_CHIP_3
 131+ E01A CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 132+ E01D 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 133+ E01F CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 134+ E022 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 135+ E024                      ; fall through
 136+ E024
 137+ E024              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope
 138+ E024              ay_init_chip:
 139+ E024 CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 140+ E027 16 0D                ld d,AY_REGS-1                  ; registers 13..0 = 0
 141+ E029 7A           .clr:   ld a,d
 142+ E02A 1E 00                ld e,0
 143+ E02C CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 144+ E02F 15                   dec d
 145+ E030 F2 29 E0             jp p,.clr
 146+ E033 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 147+ E035 1E 38                ld e,AY_MIXER_INIT
 148+ E037 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 149+ E03A 3E 0D                ld a,AY_ENV_SHAPE
 150+ E03C 1E 0D                ld e,AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD
 151+ E03E C3 65 E0             jp ay_write
 152+ E041
 153+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E041              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 155+ E041              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 156+ E041              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 157+ E041              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 158+ E041              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 159+ E041              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 160+ E041              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 161+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 162+ E041              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 163+ E041              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 164+ E041              engine_start:
 165+ E041 AF                   xor a
 166+ E042 32 66 3A             ld (eng_on),a                   ; (the interrupt off AY 1 meanwhile)
 167+ E045 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 168+ E048 22 71 3A             ld (eng_cur),hl
 169+ E04B 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 170+ E04D CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 171+ E050 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 172+ E052 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 173+ E054 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 174+ E057 3E 01                ld a,1
 175+ E059 32 66 3A             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 176+ E05C C9                   ret
 177+ E05D
 178+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 179+ E05D              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 180+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 181+ E05D              ay_select:
 182+ E05D F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 183+ E05F 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 184+ E062 ED 79                out (c),a
 185+ E064 C9                   ret
 186+ E065
 187+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 188+ E065              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 189+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E065              ay_write:
 191+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 192+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 193+ E06A 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 194+ E06C ED 59                out (c),e
 195+ E06E C9                   ret

 343+ C27B              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 344+ C27B              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 345+ C27B              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 346+ C27B              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for

 391+ C2C9              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 392+ C2C9              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 393+ C2C9              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 394+ C2C9              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 395+ C2C9              pitch_damp:
 396+ C2C9 2A 5C AF             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 397+ C2CC 7C                   ld a,h
 398+ C2CD B5                   or l
 399+ C2CE C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 400+ C2CF 7C                   ld a,h
 401+ C2D0 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 402+ C2D1 CD 14 AF             call abs_hl
 403+ C2D4 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 404+ C2D5 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 405+ C2D7 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 406+ C2D9 7A                   ld a,d
 407+ C2DA B7                   or a
 408+ C2DB 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 409+ C2DD 7B                   ld a,e
 410+ C2DE FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 411+ C2E0 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 412+ C2E2 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 413+ C2E5 B7           .sub:   or a
 414+ C2E6 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 415+ C2E8 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 416+ C2EA 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 417+ C2ED F1           .sgn:   pop af
 418+ C2EE 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 419+ C2EF DC 0D AF             call c,neg_hl
 420+ C2F2 22 5C AF             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 421+ C2F5 C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Bofors cannon (WPN_BOFORS, a wing pylon, BOFORS_SHOTS shells): the machine
  41+ C000              ; gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_BOFORS, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; BOFORS_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: BOFORS_DMG within
  43+ C000              ; BOFORS_R (3 m) on each axis, BOFORS_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the Bofors
  46+ C000              ; cannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================

 271+ C1AF              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 272+ C1AF              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 273+ C1AF              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 274+ C1AF              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 275+ C1AF              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 276+ C1AF              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 277+ C1AF              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 278+ C1AF              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  Then the drawn
 279+ C1AF              ; marks are cleared for this frame's drawing.

1163+ C7E6              pad_service:
1164+ C7E6 CD 8D AA             call cam_cell_ptr
1165+ C7E9 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1166+ C7EA E6 1F                and CELL_CODE
1167+ C7EC FE 10                cp PAD_CODE
1168+ C7EE 28 05                jr z,.pad
1169+ C7F0 AF                   xor a                           ; landed elsewhere: nothing
1170+ C7F1 32 76 D0             ld (svc_on),a
1171+ C7F4 C9                   ret
1172+ C7F5 3A 76 D0     .pad:   ld a,(svc_on)
1173+ C7F8 B7                   or a
1174+ C7F9 20 13                jr nz,.go
1175+ C7FB 3C                   inc a                           ; just landed: start the counts
1176+ C7FC 32 76 D0             ld (svc_on),a
1177+ C7FF 3E 05                ld a,REPAIR_FRAMES
1178+ C801 32 77 D0             ld (svc_rep),a
1179+ C804 21 78 D0             ld hl,svc_rel
1180+ C807 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
1181+ C809 36 00        .cl:    ld (hl),0                       ; (0: its interval starts next)
1182+ C80B 23                   inc hl
1183+ C80C 10 FB                djnz .cl
1184+ C80E 3A F0 AF     .go:    ld a,(boost_fitted)             ; the booster: refuelled 1 a frame
1185+ C811 B7                   or a
1186+ C812 28 0B                jr z,.nf
1187+ C814 3A F1 AF             ld a,(boost_fuel)
1188+ C817 FE C8                cp BOOST_FUEL_MAX
1189+ C819 30 04                jr nc,.nf
1190+ C81B 3C                   inc a
1191+ C81C 32 F1 AF             ld (boost_fuel),a
1192+ C81F 21 77 D0     .nf:    ld hl,svc_rep                   ; repair
1193+ C822 35                   dec (hl)
1194+ C823 20 0D                jr nz,.rl
1195+ C825 36 05                ld (hl),REPAIR_FRAMES
1196+ C827 3A 6F AF             ld a,(vtol_hp)
1197+ C82A FE 32                cp VTOL_HP
1198+ C82C 30 04                jr nc,.rl                       ; (undamaged)
1199+ C82E 3C                   inc a
1200+ C82F 32 6F AF             ld (vtol_hp),a
1201+ C832 DD 21 5F AF  .rl:    ld ix,wpn_slots                 ; reload, slot by slot
1202+ C836 21 78 D0             ld hl,svc_rel
1203+ C839 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
1204+ C83B C5           .sl:    push bc
1205+ C83C DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+WPN_TYPE)
1206+ C83F E5                   push hl
1207+ C840 CD E1 AA             call wpn_cfg_ptr                ; (resident)
1208+ C843 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1209+ C844 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = its full load (WCFG_LOAD)
1210+ C845 23                   inc hl
1211+ C846 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; frames a shot (WCFG_RELOAD)
1212+ C847 E1                   pop hl
1213+ C848 B7                   or a
1214+ C849 28 16                jr z,.nx                        ; doesn't reload (or an empty slot)
1215+ C84B 47                   ld b,a                          ; B = frames a shot
1216+ C84C DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+WPN_AMMO)
1217+ C84F B9                   cp c
1218+ C850 30 0D                jr nc,.full
1219+ C852 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1220+ C853 B7                   or a
1221+ C854 20 01                jr nz,.cnt
1222+ C856 70                   ld (hl),b                       ; a new interval
1223+ C857 35           .cnt:   dec (hl)
1224+ C858 20 07                jr nz,.nx
1225+ C85A DD 34 01             inc (ix+WPN_AMMO)               ; one more shot
1226+ C85D 18 02                jr .nx
1227+ C85F 36 00        .full:  ld (hl),0
1228+ C861 23           .nx:    inc hl
1229+ C862 DD 23                inc ix
1230+ C864 DD 23                inc ix
1231+ C866 C1                   pop bc
1232+ C867 10 D2                djnz .sl
1233+ C869 C9                   ret
1234+ C86A
1235+ C86A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1236+ C86A              ; Pulse laser: SPACE held with the laser in the centre slot fires a beam for
1237+ C86A              ; LASER_ON frames, then it cools for LASER_COOL frames.  Each beam frame the
1238+ C86A              ; beam is traced from the muzzle along the current view direction (the round
1239+ C86A              ; walk, LASER_RANGE long) to the first building, ground or zombie, killing a
1240+ C86A              ; zombie it reaches.  It is kept in laser_rec as a round (state 3) whose
1241+ C86A              ; path runs from the muzzle to where the beam stops; draw_bullets clips it
1242+ C86A              ; to the view, so it rises from the bottom edge of the screen.
1243+ C86A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1244+ C86A              laser_update:
1245+ C86A 3A 7D D0             ld a,(las_on)
1246+ C86D B7                   or a
1247+ C86E 20 25                jr nz,.beam
1248+ C870 32 1C B3             ld (laser_rec+B_STATE),a        ; no beam this frame
1249+ C873 3A 7E D0             ld a,(las_cool)
1250+ C876 B7                   or a
1251+ C877 28 05                jr z,.ready
1252+ C879 3D                   dec a                           ; cooling down
1253+ C87A 32 7E D0             ld (las_cool),a
1254+ C87D C9                   ret
1255+ C87E CD DC C7     .ready: call sel_slot
1256+ C881 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1257+ C882 FE 02                cp WPN_LASER
1258+ C884 C0                   ret nz
1259+ C885 3E 09                ld a,K_FIRE
1260+ C887 CD BE E0             call key_held
1261+ C88A C8                   ret z
1262+ C88B 3E 03                ld a,LASER_ON
1263+ C88D 32 7D D0             ld (las_on),a
1264+ C890 3E 02                ld a,SFX_LASER                  ; a new pulse: its zap
1265+ C892 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a
1266+ C895 21 7D D0     .beam:  ld hl,las_on
1267+ C898 35                   dec (hl)
1268+ C899 20 05                jr nz,.on
1269+ C89B 3E 08                ld a,LASER_COOL                 ; last beam frame: cool down next
1270+ C89D 32 7E D0             ld (las_cool),a
1271+ C8A0 DD 21 1C B3  .on:    ld ix,laser_rec
1272+ C8A4 21 00 06             ld hl,LASER_RANGE
1273+ C8A7 CD 94 C5             call spawn_round                ; (start of path = the muzzle)
1274+ C8AA DD 36 19 01          ld (ix+B_DMG),LASER_DMG         ; per beam frame on a target
1275+ C8AE CD F9 C9             call bullet_step                ; trace it to the first thing it meets
1276+ C8B1 DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+B_STATE)
1277+ C8B4 B7                   or a
1278+ C8B5 C8                   ret z                           ; off the map (can't, inside the wall)
1279+ C8B6 DD 36 00 03          ld (ix+B_STATE),3               ; beam
1280+ C8BA C9                   ret
1281+ C8BB
1282+ C8BB              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1283+ C8BB              ; Particles (pool `particles`, drawn by draw_particles): zombie bursts and
1284+ C8BB              ; rocket / missile bursts
1285+ C8BB              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1286+ C8BB              ; IX = a zombie just killed: spray NPART_BURST green particles from its body
1287+ C8BB              ; (PART_Y up), each with a random velocity: sideways -4..3 units a frame in
1288+ C8BB              ; x and z, upwards 2..5
1289+ C8BB              part_burst:
1290+ C8BB DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1291+ C8BE DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1292+ C8C1 22 C3 D0             ld (ps_x),hl
1293+ C8C4 21 0D 00             ld hl,PART_Y
1294+ C8C7 22 C5 D0             ld (ps_y),hl
1295+ C8CA DD 6E 02             ld l,(ix+2)
1296+ C8CD DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
1297+ C8D0 22 C7 D0             ld (ps_z),hl
1298+ C8D3 21 3B 08             ld hl,PART_COL0 | PART_LIFE<<8
1299+ C8D6 22 C9 D0             ld (ps_col),hl                  ; (and ps_life)
1300+ C8D9 AF                   xor a
1301+ C8DA 32 CB D0             ld (ps_fire),a
1302+ C8DD 0E 0A                ld c,NPART_BURST
1303+ C8DF 18 21                jr part_spray
1304+ C8E1
1305+ C8E1              ; A rocket or missile burst at rb_x/y/z: rb_parts orange particles for
1306+ C8E1              ; FIRE_LIFE frames, flying out faster than a zombie's (x and z -8..7 units
1307+ C8E1              ; a frame, y -2..5)
1308+ C8E1              fire_burst:
1309+ C8E1 2A CC D0             ld hl,(rb_x)
1310+ C8E4 22 C3 D0             ld (ps_x),hl
1311+ C8E7 2A CE D0             ld hl,(rb_y)
1312+ C8EA 22 C5 D0             ld (ps_y),hl
1313+ C8ED 2A D0 D0             ld hl,(rb_z)

1316+ C8F6 22 C9 D0             ld (ps_col),hl
1317+ C8F9 3E 01                ld a,1
1318+ C8FB 32 CB D0             ld (ps_fire),a
1319+ C8FE 3A C2 D0             ld a,(rb_parts)
1320+ C901 4F                   ld c,a
1321+ C902                      ; fall through
1322+ C902
1323+ C902              ; Spray C particles from ps_x/y/z, colour ps_col (age 1), lasting ps_life
1324+ C902              ; frames, velocities by ps_fire.  Uses free particles only; if the pool
1325+ C902              ; runs out, fewer.  Preserves IX.
1326+ C902              part_spray:

1349+ C93F B7                   or a
1350+ C940 20 1E                jr nz,.fire

1352+ C943 E6 07                and 7
1353+ C945 D6 04                sub 4
1354+ C947 FD 77 07             ld (iy+7),a                     ; vx -4..3
1355+ C94A 7C                   ld a,h
1356+ C94B E6 07                and 7
1357+ C94D D6 04                sub 4
1358+ C94F FD 77 09             ld (iy+9),a                     ; vz -4..3
1359+ C952 7D                   ld a,l
1360+ C953 0F                   rrca
1361+ C954 0F                   rrca
1362+ C955 0F                   rrca
1363+ C956 0F                   rrca
1364+ C957 E6 03                and 3
1365+ C959 C6 02                add a,2
1366+ C95B FD 77 08             ld (iy+8),a                     ; vy 2..5 (up)
1367+ C95E 18 1C                jr .v

1369+ C961 E6 0F                and 15
1370+ C963 D6 08                sub 8
1371+ C965 FD 77 07             ld (iy+7),a                     ; vx -8..7
1372+ C968 7C                   ld a,h
1373+ C969 E6 0F                and 15
1374+ C96B D6 08                sub 8
1375+ C96D FD 77 09             ld (iy+9),a                     ; vz -8..7
1376+ C970 7D                   ld a,l
1377+ C971 0F                   rrca
1378+ C972 0F                   rrca
1379+ C973 0F                   rrca
1380+ C974 0F                   rrca
1381+ C975 E6 07                and 7
1382+ C977 D6 02                sub 2
1383+ C979 FD 77 08             ld (iy+8),a                     ; vy -2..5
1384+ C97C C1           .v:     pop bc
1385+ C97D 0D                   dec c
1386+ C97E 28 07                jr z,.done
1387+ C980 11 0C 00     .nx:    ld de,PREC
1388+ C983 FD 19                add iy,de
1389+ C985 10 83                djnz .lp
1390+ C987 FD E1        .done:  pop iy
1391+ C989 C9                   ret
1392+ C98A
1393+ C98A              ; Age every particle; past its life (+11) it is freed.  Move the rest by
1394+ C98A              ; their velocity, with gravity, stopping on the ground.
1395+ C98A              part_update:
1396+ C98A DD 21 3C B3          ld ix,particles
1397+ C98E 06 3C                ld b,NPART

1416+ C9B5 DD 74 02             ld (ix+2),h

1419+ C9BE DD 66 06             ld h,(ix+6)

1422+ C9C7 DD 74 06             ld (ix+6),h
1423+ C9CA DD 7E 08             ld a,(ix+8)                     ; y += vy, vy -= gravity
1424+ C9CD DD 6E 03             ld l,(ix+3)
1425+ C9D0 DD 66 04             ld h,(ix+4)

1428+ C9D8 28 09                jr z,.up

1442+ C9F9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1443+ C9F9              ; Move round IX one frame along its path, stopping at the first thing it hits
1444+ C9F9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1447+ C9F9                      ; fresh round's first step, which is drawn from the muzzle

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up.  Layer 2 is hidden and the menu is drawn on the ULA
   5+ C000              ; screen with opaque paper.  Every frame it advances the random number
   6+ C000              ; generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start from the same seed each time
   7+ C000              ; (the wait for a key press varies), then reads the keys:
   8+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
   9+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  10+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  11+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  12+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  13+ C000              ; game_over_screen (the landing pad destroyed) shows GAME OVER for 10
  14+ C000              ; seconds, then returns here.
